question: Why is Diamagnetism said to be an inherent property of all matter, even though many materials appear to be Paramagnetic or Ferromagnetic?

options.A: Because all atoms have protons which are diamagnetic.
options.B: Because the effect arises from the intrinsic spin of electrons found in all matter.
options.C: Because an external field always induces a change in electron orbital motion that opposes the field, but this weak effect is often masked by stronger effects.
options.D: Because at absolute zero temperature, all materials become diamagnetic.
